definitions.QA_video_macro: unweighted mean of within-video question accuracy; videos with no questions in a subset are excluded and counted
definitions.short_actions: official duration <= 2.0 seconds, compared in microseconds
definitions.event_time: closed official interval, using actual decoded source PTS; source frame IDs deduplicated
definitions.coverage_micro: retained eligible official action instances divided by eligible action instances
definitions.coverage_video_macro: unweighted mean of within-video conditional event retention, excluding videos with no eligible events
definitions.observable_hit_rate: one retained source frame conditional on one source frame originally observed
definitions.two_frame_retention_rate: two DISTINCT retained source frames conditional on two distinct frames originally observed; not a readability score
definitions.pair_witness_retention_rate: one complete retained input pair with two distinct in-interval source frames, conditional on such a pair originally existing; not an action recognition score
definitions.zero_observation: actions absent from all 64 observed source frames; separately reported, not treated as selector-induced losses

limitations: All analyses are development exploration with no multiple-testing correction or independent-confirmation claim.
Paired bootstrap uses videos, 10000 resamples and seed 17; participant identity is unknown.
Overlapping official action labels count as separate instances, not independent temporal repetitions.
Temporal frame coverage does not establish readability, action recognition or QA benefit.
No-memory and full/last references are summarized, but different actual budgets are excluded from matched-budget comparisons.
